scheme_name: Indian Footwear, Leather & Accessories Development Programme (IFLADP)
overview: The Indian Footwear, Leather & Accessories Development Programme (IFLDP) is a Central Sector Scheme implemented by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, with a total outlay of Rs.1700 Crores for the period 2021-2026. It consists of six sub-schemes: Sustainable Technology and Environmental Promotion (STEP), Integrated Development of Leather Sector (IDLS), Brand Promotion of Indian Brands in Leather and Footwear Sector, Development of Design Studios in Leather and Footwear Sector, Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster Development (MLFACD), and Establishment of Institutional Facilities (EIF). The scheme aims to provide grant-based financial assistance to eligible units for modernization, technology upgradation, cluster development, and institutional support in the leather and footwear sector.
objectives: Promote sustainable technology and environmental protection in the leather sector
Enable integrated development of the leather sector through modernization and technology upgradation
Promote Indian brands in the leather and footwear sector domestically and internationally
Develop design studios to enhance product innovation and value addition
Develop mega leather, footwear, and accessories clusters for infrastructure and common facilities
Establish institutional facilities for testing, training, and research support
eligibility: Eligible units must submit proposals/applications through the online NSWS portal (https://www.nsws.gov.in) for availing grant assistance under the respective sub-schemes. Assistance is subject to appraisal by PIUs (FDDI and CLRI for IDLS), recommendations by the Steering Committee, and final approval by DPIIT. Mere submission of an application does not entitle an applicant to GoI assistance.
benefits: Financial grant assistance for project implementation under the six sub-schemes. Non-financial benefits include technical appraisal by PIUs, guidance on project formulation, and access to institutional support for modernization, cluster development, brand promotion, design studio development, and environmental sustainability initiatives.
financial_support: Grant-based financial assistance is provided under the six sub-schemes of IFLDP. The assistance is disbursed to applicant units after due appraisal by PIUs (FDDI and CLRI for IDLS), forwarding to DPIIT, and approval by the Steering Committee. The quantum of support varies by sub-scheme and project proposal, subject to availability of funds and scheme guidelines.
application_process: 1. Identify the relevant sub-scheme under IFLDP (STEP, IDLS, Brand Promotion, Design Studios, MLFACD, or EIF). 2. Prepare the project proposal as per the guidelines of the respective sub-scheme. 3. Submit the application through the online NSWS portal (https://www.nsws.gov.in) for availing grant. 4. For IDLS sub-scheme, applications are submitted to PIUs (FDDI and CLRI) via the NSWS portal. 5. After due appraisal by PIUs, applications are forwarded to DPIIT for consideration by the Steering Committee. 6. Upon approval by the Steering Committee, grant is disbursed to the applicant unit. 7. Note: Mere submission does not entitle assistance; approval is subject to appraisal and recommendations.
deadlines: For IDLS sub-scheme: applications must be submitted on or before 10th July 2025 (15-day window from 25th June 2025). For all other sub-schemes: NSWS portal is closed with immediate effect from 25th June 2025. The scheme period is till 31st March 2026 or till further review, whichever is earlier.
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India
caveats: Mere submission of an application does not entitle an applicant to GoI assistance; assistance is subject to appraisal and recommendations by PIUs and final approval by the Steering Committee.
For IDLS sub-scheme, the NSWS portal will be closed within 15 days from 25th June 2025 (by 10th July 2025).
For all other sub-schemes (STEP, Brand Promotion, Design Studios, MLFACD, EIF), the NSWS portal is closed with immediate effect from 25th June 2025.
The scheme is valid till 31st March 2026 or till further review, whichever is earlier.
